# Adapter test fixtures

Most fixtures are generated at test time by `../pdf_writer.dart` (Courier text at known positions; no files).

- `locked_1p.pdf`: copied from `spikes/pdfrx_spike/assets/fixtures/`, generated by `spikes/pdfrx_spike/tool/make_fixtures.py` (fake text, AES-256, fake password `Test1234`). The tiny writer here cannot encrypt, so this file is committed.
- `plain_1p.pdf`, `ten_pages.pdf`: copied from the same spike folder and generated by the same script (fake text, Vera 9 pt, with 14/10 pt PROBE labels overprinted). Used for the overlay (stamp/watermark) tests.
